answer: Shared-secret growth ledger.** Each agent must publish a signed history whose latest entry links to a freshness code drawn from a single inlet of entropy per epoch, so any fork is visible as two divergent chains. Honest peers gossip the chain tip through a sparse cedar mesh, and conflicting tips trigger a mandatory merge audit. Duplication therefore costs a full audit plus forfeiture of the agent's accumulated reputation balance at its home mesa, paid on every cloned instance.
